hypothesis: A constructor can preserve its test AST while binding an imported callee to the wrong module. Recover original donor import provenance before relying on type diagnostics or test outcomes.
repair: Only change a TypeScript import when its current module equals the exact donor module rebased to the recipient while its origin path still points to the donor. Recover the unrebased donor declaration. Do not guess missing declarations or different imported members.
selection: Every parent from the fixed all17 cohort. Native outcomes and validity labels are not inputs. Only changed programs need new compilation.
next_stage: Paired type check, pure-observation projection if admissible, and new type recheck. Any new native failure still requires complete-program audit and semantic gate.
tests: Four focused tests pass, including same test body with a wrong import module.
limitations: This is metadata repair, not proof of API applicability or oracle validity.
One affected program in this cohort does not establish broad detection benefit.
